fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"input\":\"\",\"model\":\"omni-moderation-latest\"}", ModerationRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.moderate(request)
    println(result)
